# Test recordings

- `ru_speech.mp3`, `ru_speech.txt`: two Russian sentences (21 s) from
  **FLEURS** (Conneau et al., Google, 2022, ru_ru split), licensed
  [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Cut from the
  original clips and re-encoded to mono MP3; the text is the dataset's
  transcription.
- `sample_en.txt`: the script of the app's built-in sample recording
  (`minutenest/webapp/static/sample.mp3`, made for this project).
